text.autoconfig.TNT Config.title: Roulette Settings
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.affect: Off by default so you can build sets safely.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.resetS: Dying resets the risk meter to zero.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.breakE: Chance added for every safe block.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.ignore: Grass, flowers and torches never trigger TNT.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.placeE: Chance added for every safe placement.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.maxCha: The risk meter never rises above this.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.dudCha: Share of triggers that fizzle harmlessly.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.graceS: Seconds of safety after a TNT or dud.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.showCy: Show Revolver Cylinder Guess. Great for chat engagement.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.clickS: Show Revolver Cylinder Guess. Great for chat engagement.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.announ: Broadcasts a message when TNT spawns.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.chambe: Number of Chambers in the Revolver. It affects the chances.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.bullet: Maximum number of bullets in loaded in the chamber. Higher the bullet count, higher the chances of TNT spawning.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.respin: Respining makes the probability linear instead of being incremental.
text.autoconfig.TNT Config.option.misfir: Chance in percent of spawning a dud instead of blowing you up.
